text: He ought to be slow to believe and to act, nor should he himself show fear, but proceed in a temperate manner with prudence and humanity, so that too much confidence may not make him incautious and too much distrust render him intolerable.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XVII, Concerning cruelty and clemency, and whether it is better to be loved than feared
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
